CONTROLS.NAME: mirror_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Mirror the scene across an axis for a symmetrical look.

CONTROLS.NAME: mirror_change
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: mirror on MUST BE SET TO ON. Change the mirror location on every press to get different kinds of symmetry.

CONTROLS.NAME: refract_type
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Refract the scene through one of two surfaces. 1/3 up selects an 'X' surface. 2/3 up selects a diamond surface. All the way down for None. Both move on the beat.

CONTROLS.NAME: RGB_Split
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn on an RGB Split effect that splits more when the bass hits.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_scheme
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Choose between your two selected colors or a full spectrum color scheme.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_low
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: color scheme MUST BE SET TO ON. Color of planet surface.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_high
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: color scheme MUST BE SET TO ON. Color of atmosphere.
